concept.title: Hybrid Cloud Console help options
concept.shortdesc: There are several ways to get help with Red Hat services from within the Hybrid Cloud Console.

conbody.p: From the Help panel, you can:

ul.li: Open a Red Hat support case
Check the status of Red Hat web sites
Access quick starts and documentation learning resources
Submit feedback about the Hybrid Cloud Console

conbody.p: From the chat icon at the bottom of the screen, or from the robot icon in the Help panel, you can access several AI assistants. Use these AI assistants to help you find answers and configure settings specific to your use case, including:
